decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY requiring labels on all interactive fields and defining their text rule; no additional update or removal is needed.
Translation coverage for interactive-field labels does not change the document's Microsoft Word default-language configuration.
Requiring translated labels on all interactive fields does not alter whether field contents are independent or duplicated.
The source specifies label text and coverage, not whether a field's placeholder clears when activated.
The label-translation instruction does not change the selected editable-text representation or its architecture quality.
Label translation and coverage do not change the Title field's formatting-retention behavior.
The source requires labels but does not modify or resolve the separate requirement concerning grey visual cues and field discoverability.
The source does not enable, disable, or otherwise change the Board Meeting dropdown control.
Requiring translated field labels does not change the calendar-dropdown selection method for date fields.
The source does not change the checklist control's type or enabled state.
Interactive-field label translation does not alter the requirement for stable rendering across users or its supported environment.
The source does not change the legacy-content transfer workflow, layout stability, or style behavior during copy-paste.
